text.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلصَّٰٓفَّٰتِ صَفًّۭا

translations.asad: CONSIDER these [messages] ranged in serried ranks,
translations.sahih: By those [angels] lined up in rows

translations.asad: and restraining [from evil] by a call to restraint,
translations.sahih: And those who drive [the clouds]

translations.asad: and conveying [to all the world] a reminder:
translations.sahih: And those who recite the message,

translations.asad: Verily, most surely, your God is One –
translations.sahih: Indeed, your God is One,

text.arabic: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَرَبُّ ٱلْمَشَٰرِقِ

translations.asad: the Sustainer of the heavens and the earth and of all that is between them, and the Sustainer of all the points of sunrise!
translations.sahih: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them and Lord of the sunrises.

text.arabic: إِنَّا زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِزِينَةٍ ٱلْكَوَاكِبِ

translations.asad: Behold, We have adorned the skies nearest to the earth with the beauty of stars,
translations.sahih: Indeed, We have adorned the nearest heaven with an adornment of stars

translations.asad: and have made them secure against every rebellious, satanic force,
translations.sahih: And as protection against every rebellious devil

text.arabic: لَّا يَسَّمَّعُونَ إِلَى ٱلْمَلَإِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ وَيُقْذَفُونَ مِن كُلِّ جَانِبٍۢ

translations.asad: [so that] they [who seek to learn the unknowable] should not be able to overhear the host on high, but shall be repelled from all sides,
translations.sahih: [So] they may not listen to the exalted assembly [of angels] and are pelted from every side,

translations.asad: cast out [from all grace], with lasting suffering in store for them [in the life to come];
translations.sahih: Repelled; and for them is a constant punishment,

text.arabic: إِلَّا مَنْ خَطِفَ ٱلْخَطْفَةَ فَأَتْبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٌۭ ثَاقِبٌۭ

translations.asad: but if anyone does succeed in snatching a glimpse [of such knowledge], he is [henceforth] pursued by a piercing flame.
translations.sahih: Except one who snatches [some words] by theft, but they are pursued by a burning flame, piercing [in brightness].

text.arabic: فَٱسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَهُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَم مَّنْ خَلَقْنَآ ۚ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَٰهُم مِّن طِينٍۢ لَّازِبٍۭ

translations.asad: AND NOW ask those [who deny the truth] to enlight­en thee: Were they more difficult to create than all those [untold marvels] that We have created? - for, behold, them have We created out of [mere] clay commingled with water!
translations.sahih: Then inquire of them, [O Muhammad], "Are they a stronger [or more difficult] creation or those [others] We have created?" Indeed, We created men from sticky clay.

translations.asad: Nay, but whereas thou dost marvel, they [only] scoff;
translations.sahih: But you wonder, while they mock,

translations.asad: and when they are reminded [of the truth], they refuse to take it to heart;
translations.sahih: And when they are reminded, they remember not.

translations.asad: and when they become aware of a [divine] message, they turn it to ridicule
translations.sahih: And when they see a sign, they ridicule

text.arabic: وَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌۭ مُّبِينٌ

translations.asad: and say: “This is clearly nothing but [a mortal’s] spellbinding eloquence!
translations.sahih: And say, "This is not but obvious magic.

text.arabic: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ

translations.asad: Why - after we have died and become mere dust and bones, shall we, forsooth, be raised from the dead? –
translations.sahih: When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?

translations.asad: and perhaps also our forebears of old?”
translations.sahih: And our forefathers [as well]?"

translations.asad: Say: “Yea, indeed - and most abject will you then be!” –
translations.sahih: Say, "Yes, and you will be [rendered] contemptible."

text.arabic: فَإِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌۭ وَٰحِدَةٌۭ فَإِذَا هُمْ يَنظُرُونَ

translations.asad: for that [resurrection which they deride] will be [upon them of a sudden, as if it were] but a single accusing cry - and then, lo! they will begin to see [the truth]
translations.sahih: It will be only one shout, and at once they will be observing.

translations.asad: and will say: “Oh, woe unto us! This is the Day of Judgment!”
translations.sahih: They will say, "O woe to us! This is the Day of Recompense."

text.arabic: هَٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ

translations.asad: [And they will be told:] “This is the Day of Distinction [between the true and the false - the Day] which you were wont to call a lie!”
translations.sahih: [They will be told], "This is the Day of Judgement which you used to deny."

text.arabic: ۞ ٱحْشُرُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ وَأَزْوَٰجَهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْبُدُونَ

translations.asad: [And God will thus command:] “Assemble all those who were bent on evildoing, together with others of their ilk and [with] all that they were wont to worship
translations.sahih: [The angels will be ordered], "Gather those who committed wrong, their kinds, and what they used to worship

text.arabic: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَٱهْدُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ

translations.asad: instead of God, and lead them all onto the way to the blazing fire,
translations.sahih: Other than Allah, and guide them to the path of Hellfire

translations.asad: and halt them [there]!” [And then,] behold, they shall be asked,
translations.sahih: And stop them; indeed, they are to be questioned."

translations.asad: “How is it that [now] you cannot succour one another?”
translations.sahih: [They will be asked], "What is [wrong] with you? Why do you not help each other?"

translations.asad: Nay, but on that Day they would willingly surrender [to God];
translations.sahih: But they, that Day, are in surrender.

translations.asad: but [since it will be too late,] they will turn upon one another, demanding of each other [to relieve them of the burden of their past sins].
translations.sahih: And they will approach one another blaming each other.

text.arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ تَأْتُونَنَا عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ

translations.asad: Some [of them] will say: “Behold, you were wont to approach us [deceptively] from the right!”
translations.sahih: They will say, "Indeed, you used to come at us from the right."

translations.asad: [To which] the others will reply: “Nay, you yourselves were bereft of all faith!
translations.sahih: The oppressors will say, "Rather, you [yourselves] were not believers,

text.arabic: وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا عَلَيْكُم مِّن سُلْطَٰنٍۭ ۖ بَلْ كُنتُمْ قَوْمًۭا طَٰغِينَ

translations.asad: Moreover, we had no power at all over you: nay, you were people filled with overweening arrogance!
translations.sahih: And we had over you no authority, but you were a transgressing people.

text.arabic: فَحَقَّ عَلَيْنَا قَوْلُ رَبِّنَآ ۖ إِنَّا لَذَآئِقُونَ

translations.asad: But now our Sustainer’s word has come true against us [as well]: verily, we are bound to taste [the fruit of our sins].
translations.sahih: So the word of our Lord has come into effect upon us; indeed, we will taste [punishment].

translations.asad: So then, [if it be true that] we have caused you to err grievously - behold, we ourselves had been lost in grievous error!”
translations.sahih: And we led you to deviation; indeed, we were deviators."

translations.asad: And, verily, on that Day they all will share in their common suffering.
translations.sahih: So indeed they, that Day, will be sharing in the punishment.

translations.asad: Verily, thus shall We deal with all who were lost in sin:
translations.sahih: Indeed, that is how We deal with the criminals.

text.arabic: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوٓا۟ إِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ

translations.asad: for, behold, whenever they were told, “There is no deity save God,” they would glory in their arrogance
translations.sahih: Indeed they, when it was said to them, "There is no deity but Allah," were arrogant

text.arabic: وَيَقُولُونَ أَئِنَّا لَتَارِكُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَتِنَا لِشَاعِرٍۢ مَّجْنُونٍۭ

translations.asad: and would say, “Shall we, then, give up our deities at the bidding of a mad poet?”
translations.sahih: And were saying, "Are we to leave our gods for a mad poet?"

translations.asad: Nay, but he [whom you call a mad poet] has brought the truth; and he confirms the truth of [what the earlier of God’s] message-bearers [have taught].
translations.sahih: Rather, the Prophet has come with the truth and confirmed the [previous] messengers.

translations.asad: Behold, you will indeed taste grievous suffering [in the life to come],
translations.sahih: Indeed, you [disbelievers] will be tasters of the painful punishment,

text.arabic: وَمَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

translations.asad: although you shall not be requited for aught but what you were wont to do.
translations.sahih: And you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do -

translations.asad: Not so, however, God’s true servants:
translations.sahih: But not the chosen servants of Allah.

translations.asad: [in the hereafter,] theirs shall be a sustenance which they will recognize
translations.sahih: Those will have a provision determined -

translations.asad: as the fruits [of their life on earth]; and honoured shall they be
translations.sahih: Fruits; and they will be honored

translations.asad: in gardens of bliss,
translations.sahih: In gardens of pleasure

translations.asad: facing one another [in love] upon thrones of happiness.
translations.sahih: On thrones facing one another.

translations.asad: A cup will be passed round among them [with a drink] from unsullied springs,
translations.sahih: There will be circulated among them a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring,

translations.asad: clear, delightful to those who drink it:
translations.sahih: White and delicious to the drinkers;

text.arabic: لَا فِيهَا غَوْلٌۭ وَلَا هُمْ عَنْهَا يُنزَفُونَ

translations.asad: no headiness will be in it, and they will not get drunk thereon.
translations.sahih: No bad effect is there in it, nor from it will they be intoxicated.

translations.asad: And with them will be mates of modest gaze, most beautiful of eye,
translations.sahih: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances, with large, [beautiful] eyes,

translations.asad: [as free of faults] as if they were hidden [ostrich] eggs.
translations.sahih: As if they were [delicate] eggs, well-protected.

translations.asad: And they will all turn to one another, asking each other [about their past lives].
translations.sahih: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.

text.arabic: قَالَ قَآئِلٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ إِنِّى كَانَ لِى قَرِينٌۭ

translations.asad: One of them speaks thus: “Behold, I had [on earth] a close companion
translations.sahih: A speaker among them will say, "Indeed, I had a companion [on earth]

translations.asad: who was wont to ask [me], ‘Why - art thou really one of those who believe it to be true
translations.sahih: Who would say, 'Are you indeed of those who believe

text.arabic: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَدِينُونَ

translations.asad: [that] after we have died and become mere dust and bones we shall, forsooth, be brought to judgment?”’
translations.sahih: That when we have died and become dust and bones, we will indeed be recompensed?'"

translations.asad: [And] he adds: “Would you like to look [and see him]?” –
translations.sahih: He will say, "Would you [care to] look?"

translations.asad: and then he looks and sees that [companion of his] in the midst of the blazing fire,
translations.sahih: And he will look and see him in the midst of the Hellfire.

translations.asad: and says: “By God! Verily, thou hast almost destroyed me [too, O my erstwhile companion]
translations.sahih: He will say, "By Allah, you almost ruined me.

text.arabic: وَلَوْلَا نِعْمَةُ رَبِّى لَكُنتُ مِنَ ٱلْمُحْضَرِينَ

translations.asad: for had it not been for my Sustainer’s favour, I would surely be [now] among those who are given over [to suffering]!
translations.sahih: If not for the favor of my Lord, I would have been of those brought in [to Hell].

translations.asad: But then, [O my friends in paradise,] is it [really] so that we are not to die
translations.sahih: Then, are we not to die

text.arabic: إِلَّا مَوْتَتَنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ

translations.asad: [again,] beyond our previous death, and that we shall never [again] be made to suffer?
translations.sahih: Except for our first death, and we will not be punished?"

translations.asad: Verily, this - this indeed - is the triumph supreme!”
translations.sahih: Indeed, this is the great attainment.

translations.asad: For the like of this, then, let them labour, those who labour [in God’s way]!
translations.sahih: For the like of this let the workers [on earth] work.

text.arabic: أَذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌۭ نُّزُلًا أَمْ شَجَرَةُ ٱلزَّقُّومِ

translations.asad: Is such [a paradise] the better welcome - or the [hellish] tree of deadly fruit?
translations.sahih: Is Paradise a better accommodation or the tree of zaqqum?

translations.asad: Verily, We have caused it to be a trial for evildoers:
translations.sahih: Indeed, We have made it a torment for the wrongdoers.

text.arabic: إِنَّهَا شَجَرَةٌۭ تَخْرُجُ فِىٓ أَصْلِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ

translations.asad: for, behold, it is a tree that grows in the very heart of the blazing fire [of hell],
translations.sahih: Indeed, it is a tree issuing from the bottom of the Hellfire,

translations.asad: its fruit [as repulsive] as satans’ heads;
translations.sahih: Its emerging fruit as if it was heads of the devils.

text.arabic: فَإِنَّهُمْ لَءَاكِلُونَ مِنْهَا فَمَالِـُٔونَ مِنْهَا ٱلْبُطُونَ

translations.asad: and they [who are lost in evil] are indeed bound to eat thereof, and to fill their bellies therewith.
translations.sahih: And indeed, they will eat from it and fill with it their bellies.

text.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّ لَهُمْ عَلَيْهَا لَشَوْبًۭا مِّنْ حَمِيمٍۢ

translations.asad: And, behold, above all this they will be confounded with burning des­pair!
translations.sahih: Then indeed, they will have after it a mixture of scalding water.

translations.asad: And once again: Verily, the blazing fire is their ultimate goal –
translations.sahih: Then indeed, their return will be to the Hellfire.

translations.asad: for, behold, they found their forebears on a wrong way,
translations.sahih: Indeed they found their fathers astray.

translations.asad: and [now] they make haste to follow in their footsteps!
translations.sahih: So they hastened [to follow] in their footsteps.

translations.asad: Thus, indeed, most of the people of old went astray before them,
translations.sahih: And there had already strayed before them most of the former peoples,

translations.asad: although, verily, We had sent warners unto them:
translations.sahih: And We had already sent among them warners.

translations.asad: and behold what happened in the end to those that had been warned [to no avail]!
translations.sahih: Then look how was the end of those who were warned -

translations.asad: EXCEPT for God’s true servants, [most people are apt to go astray.]
translations.sahih: But not the chosen servants of Allah.

translations.asad: And, indeed, [it was for this reason that] Noah cried unto Us - and how excellent was Our response:
translations.sahih: And Noah had certainly called Us, and [We are] the best of responders.

translations.asad: for We saved him and his household from that awesome calamity,
translations.sahih: And We saved him and his family from the great affliction.

translations.asad: and caused his offspring to endure [on earth];
translations.sahih: And We made his descendants those remaining [on the earth]

translations.asad: and We left him thus to be remembered among later generations:
translations.sahih: And left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:

translations.asad: “Peace be upon Noah throughout all the worlds!”
translations.sahih: "Peace upon Noah among the worlds."

translations.asad: Verily, thus do We reward the doers of good –
translations.sahih: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

translations.asad: for he was truly one of our believing servants:
translations.sahih: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.

translations.asad: [and so We saved him and those who followed him] and then We caused the others to drown.
translations.sahih: Then We drowned the disbelievers.

translations.asad: AND, BEHOLD, of his persuasion was Abraham, too,
translations.sahih: And indeed, among his kind was Abraham,

translations.asad: when he turned to his Sustainer with a heart free of evil,
translations.sahih: When he came to his Lord with a sound heart

text.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَاذَا تَعْبُدُونَ

translations.asad: and [thus] spoke to his father and his people: “What is it that you worship?
translations.sahih: [And] when he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship?

translations.asad: Do you want [to bow down before] a lie - [before] deities other than God?
translations.sahih: Is it falsehood [as] gods other than Allah you desire?

translations.asad: What, then, do you think of the Sustainer of all the worlds?”
translations.sahih: Then what is your thought about the Lord of the worlds?"

translations.asad: Then he cast a glance at the stars,
translations.sahih: And he cast a look at the stars

translations.asad: and said, “Verily, I am sick [at heart]!”
translations.sahih: And said, "Indeed, I am [about to be] ill."

translations.asad: and at that they turned their backs on him and went away.
translations.sahih: So they turned away from him, departing.

text.arabic: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِهِمْ فَقَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ

translations.asad: Thereupon he approached their gods stealthily and said, “What! You do not eat [of the offerings placed before you]?
translations.sahih: Then he turned to their gods and said, "Do you not eat?

translations.asad: What is amiss with you that you do not speak?”
translations.sahih: What is [wrong] with you that you do not speak?"

translations.asad: And then he fell upon them, smiting them with his right hand.
translations.sahih: And he turned upon them a blow with [his] right hand.

translations.asad: [But] then the others came towards him hur­riedly [and accused him of his deed].
translations.sahih: Then the people came toward him, hastening.

translations.asad: He answered: “Do you worship something that you [yourselves] have carved,
translations.sahih: He said, "Do you worship that which you [yourselves] carve,

translations.asad: the while it is God who has created you and all your handiwork?”
translations.sahih: While Allah created you and that which you do?"

text.arabic: قَالُوا۟ ٱبْنُوا۟ لَهُۥ بُنْيَٰنًۭا فَأَلْقُوهُ فِى ٱلْجَحِيمِ

translations.asad: They exclaimed: “Build a pyre for him, and cast him into the blazing fire!”
translations.sahih: They said, "Construct for him a furnace and throw him into the burning fire."

translations.asad: But whereas they sought to do evil unto him, We [frustrated their designs, and thus] brought them low?
translations.sahih: And they intended for him a plan, but We made them the most debased.

text.arabic: وَقَالَ إِنِّى ذَاهِبٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ

translations.asad: And [Abraham] said: “Verily, I shall [leave this land and] go wherever my Sustainer will guide me!”
translations.sahih: And [then] he said, "Indeed, I will go to [where I am ordered by] my Lord; He will guide me.

translations.asad: [And he prayed:] “O my Sustainer! Bestow upon me the gift of [a son who shall be] one of the righteous!” –
translations.sahih: My Lord, grant me [a child] from among the righteous."

translations.asad: whereupon We gave him the glad tiding of a boy-child gentle [like himself]?
translations.sahih: So We gave him good tidings of a forbearing boy.

text.arabic: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعْىَ قَالَ يَٰبُنَىَّ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰ فِى ٱلْمَنَامِ أَنِّىٓ أَذْبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرْ مَاذَا تَرَىٰ ۚ قَالَ يَٰٓأَبَتِ ٱفْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ ۖ سَتَجِدُنِىٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ

translations.asad: And [one day,] when [the child] had become old enough to share in his [father’s] endeavours, the latter said: “O my dear son! I have seen in a dream that I should sacrifice thee: consider, then, what would be thy view!” [Ishmael] answered: “O my father! Do as thou art bidden: thou wilt find me, if God so wills, among those who are patient in adversity!”
translations.sahih: And when he reached with him [the age of] exertion, he said, "O my son, indeed I have seen in a dream that I [must] sacrifice you, so see what you think." He said, "O my father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allah wills, of the steadfast."

translations.asad: But as soon as the two had surrendered themselves to [what they thought to be] the will of God, and [Abraham] had laid him down on his face,
translations.sahih: And when they had both submitted and he put him down upon his forehead,

translations.asad: We called out to him: “O Abraham,
translations.sahih: We called to him, "O Abraham,

text.arabic: قَدْ صَدَّقْتَ ٱلرُّءْيَآ ۚ إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ

translations.asad: thou hast already fulfilled [the purpose of] that dream- vision!” Thus, verily, do We reward the doers of good:
translations.sahih: You have fulfilled the vision." Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

translations.asad: for, behold, all this was indeed a trial, clear in itself.
translations.sahih: Indeed, this was the clear trial.

translations.asad: And We ransomed him with a tremendous sacrifice,
translations.sahih: And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice,

translations.asad: and left him thus to be remembered among later generations:
translations.sahih: And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:

translations.asad: “Peace be upon Abraham!”
translations.sahih: "Peace upon Abraham."

translations.asad: Thus do We reward the doers of good –
translations.sahih: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

translations.asad: for he was truly one of our believing servants.
translations.sahih: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.

translations.asad: And [in time] We gave him the glad tiding of Isaac, [who, too, would be] a prophet, one of the righteous;
translations.sahih: And We gave him good tidings of Isaac, a prophet from among the righteous.

text.arabic: وَبَٰرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَىٰٓ إِسْحَٰقَ ۚ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا مُحْسِنٌۭ وَظَالِمٌۭ لِّنَفْسِهِۦ مُبِينٌۭ

translations.asad: and We blessed him and Isaac: but among the offspring of these two there were [des­tined] to be both doers of good and such as would glaringly sin against themselves.
translations.sahih: And We blessed him and Isaac. But among their descendants is the doer of good and the clearly unjust to himself.

translations.asad: THUS, INDEED, did We bestow Our favour upon Moses and Aaron;
translations.sahih: And We did certainly confer favor upon Moses and Aaron.

translations.asad: and We saved them and their people from the awesome calamity [of bondage],
translations.sahih: And We saved them and their people from the great affliction,

translations.asad: and succoured them, so that [in the end] it was they who achieved victory.
translations.sahih: And We supported them so it was they who overcame.

translations.asad: And We gave them the divine writ that made [right and wrong] distinct,
translations.sahih: And We gave them the explicit Scripture,

translations.asad: and guided them the straight way,
translations.sahih: And We guided them on the straight path.

translations.asad: and left them thus to be remem­bered among later generations:
translations.sahih: And We left for them [favorable mention] among later generations:

translations.asad: “Peace be upon Moses and Aaron!”
translations.sahih: "Peace upon Moses and Aaron."

translations.asad: Thus do We reward the doers of good –
translations.sahih: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

translations.asad: for those two were truly among Our believing ser­vants.
translations.sahih: Indeed, they were of Our believing servants.

translations.asad: AND, BEHOLD, Elijah [too] was indeed one of Our message-bearers
translations.sahih: And indeed, Elias was from among the messengers,

translations.asad: when he spoke [thus] to his people: “Will you not remain conscious of God?
translations.sahih: When he said to his people, "Will you not fear Allah?

translations.asad: Will you invoke Baal and forsake [God,] the best of artisans -
translations.sahih: Do you call upon Ba'l and leave the best of creators -

translations.asad: God, your Sustainer and the Sustainer of your forebears of old?”
translations.sahih: Allah, your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers?"

translations.asad: But they gave him the lie: and therefore they will most surely be arraigned [on Judgment Day],
translations.sahih: And they denied him, so indeed, they will be brought [for punishment],

translations.asad: excepting only [those who were] God’s true servants;
translations.sahih: Except the chosen servants of Allah.

translations.asad: and him We left thus to be remem­bered among later generations:
translations.sahih: And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:

translations.asad: “Peace be upon Elijah and his followers!”
translations.sahih: "Peace upon Elias."

translations.asad: Verily, thus do We reward the doers of good –
translations.sahih: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

translations.asad: for he was truly one of Our believing servants!
translations.sahih: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.

translations.asad: AND, BEHOLD, Lot was indeed one of Our mes­sage-bearers;
translations.sahih: And indeed, Lot was among the messengers.

translations.asad: [and so,] when [We decreed the doom of his sinful town,] We saved him and his household,
translations.sahih: [So mention] when We saved him and his family, all,

translations.asad: except an old woman who was among those that stayed behind;
translations.sahih: Except his wife among those who remained [with the evildoers].

translations.asad: and then We utterly destroyed the others:
translations.sahih: Then We destroyed the others.

translations.asad: and, verily, [to this day] you pass by the remnants of their dwellings at morning-time
translations.sahih: And indeed, you pass by them in the morning

translations.asad: and by night. Will you not, then, use your reason?
translations.sahih: And at night. Then will you not use reason?

translations.asad: AND, BEHOLD, Jonah was indeed one of Our mes­sage-bearers
translations.sahih: And indeed, Jonah was among the messengers.

translations.asad: when he fled like a runaway slave onto a laden ship.
translations.sahih: [Mention] when he ran away to the laden ship.

translations.asad: And then they cast lots, and he was the one who lost;
translations.sahih: And he drew lots and was among the losers.

translations.asad: [and they cast him into the sea,] whereupon the great fish swallowed him, for he had been blameworthy.
translations.sahih: Then the fish swallowed him, while he was blameworthy.

translations.asad: And had he not been of those who [even in the deep darkness of their distress are able to] extol God’s limitless glory,
translations.sahih: And had he not been of those who exalt Allah,

text.arabic: لَلَبِثَ فِى بَطْنِهِۦٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ

translations.asad: he would indeed have remained in its belly till the Day when all shall be raised from the dead:
translations.sahih: He would have remained inside its belly until the Day they are resurrected.

translations.asad: but We caused him to be cast forth on a desert shore, sick [at heart] as he was,
translations.sahih: But We threw him onto the open shore while he was ill.

translations.asad: and caused a creeping plant to grow over him [out of the barren soil].
translations.sahih: And We caused to grow over him a gourd vine.

text.arabic: وَأَرْسَلْنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ مِا۟ئَةِ أَلْفٍ أَوْ يَزِيدُونَ

translations.asad: And [then] We sent him [once again] to [his people,] a hundred thousand [souls] or more:
translations.sahih: And We sent him to [his people of] a hundred thousand or more.

translations.asad: and [this time] they believed [in him] and so We allowed them to enjoy their life during the time allotted to them?
translations.sahih: And they believed, so We gave them enjoyment [of life] for a time.

translations.asad: AND NOW ask them to enlighten thee: Has thy Sustainer daughters, whereas they would have [only] sons?
translations.sahih: So inquire of them, [O Muhammad], "Does your Lord have daughters while they have sons?

text.arabic: أَمْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ إِنَٰثًۭا وَهُمْ شَٰهِدُونَ

translations.asad: - or is it that We have created the angels female, and they [who believe them to be divine] have witnessed [that act of creation]?
translations.sahih: Or did We create the angels as females while they were witnesses?"

translations.asad: Oh, verily, it is out of their own [inclination to] falsehood that some people assert,
translations.sahih: Unquestionably, it is out of their [invented] falsehood that they say,

translations.asad: “God has begotten [a son]”; and, verily, they are lying [too, when they say],
translations.sahih: " Allah has begotten," and indeed, they are liars.

translations.asad: “He has chosen daughters in preference to sons”!
translations.sahih: Has He chosen daughters over sons?

translations.asad: What is amiss with you and your judgment?
translations.sahih: What is [wrong] with you? How do you make judgement?

translations.asad: Will you not, then, bethink yourselves?
translations.sahih: Then will you not be reminded?

translations.asad: Or have you, perchance, a clear evidence [for your assertions]?
translations.sahih: Or do you have a clear authority?

translations.asad: Produce, then, that divine writ of yours, if you are speaking the truth!
translations.sahih: Then produce your scripture, if you should be truthful.

text.arabic: وَجَعَلُوا۟ بَيْنَهُۥ وَبَيْنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ نَسَبًۭا ۚ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمَتِ ٱلْجِنَّةُ إِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ

translations.asad: And some people have invented a kinship between Him and all manner of invisible forces although [even] these invisible forces know well that, verily, they [who thus blaspheme against God] shall indeed be arraigned [before Him on Judgment Day: for]
translations.sahih: And they have claimed between Him and the jinn a lineage, but the jinn have already known that they [who made such claims] will be brought to [punishment].

translations.asad: limitless is God in His glory, above anything that men may devise by way of definition!
translations.sahih: Exalted is Allah above what they describe,

translations.asad: Not thus, however, [behave] God’s true ser­vants:
translations.sahih: Except the chosen servants of Allah [who do not share in that sin].

translations.asad: for, verily, neither you [blasphemers] nor the objects of your worship
translations.sahih: So indeed, you [disbelievers] and whatever you worship,

translations.asad: can cause anyone to fall prey to your temptation
translations.sahih: You cannot tempt [anyone] away from Him

translations.asad: unless it be such as rushes towards the blazing fire [of his own accord]!
translations.sahih: Except he who is to [enter and] burn in the Hellfire.

text.arabic: وَمَا مِنَّآ إِلَّا لَهُۥ مَقَامٌۭ مَّعْلُومٌۭ

translations.asad: [All forces of nature praise God and say:] “Among us, too, there is none but has a place assigned to it [by Him];
translations.sahih: [The angels say], "There is not among us any except that he has a known position.

translations.asad: and, verily, we too are ranged [before Him in worship];
translations.sahih: And indeed, we are those who line up [for prayer].

translations.asad: and, verily, we too extol His limitless glory!”
translations.sahih: And indeed, we are those who exalt Allah."

translations.asad: AND, INDEED, they [who deny the truth] have always been wont to say,
translations.sahih: And indeed, the disbelievers used to say,

text.arabic: لَوْ أَنَّ عِندَنَا ذِكْرًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

translations.asad: “If only we had a tradition [to this effect] from our forebears,
translations.sahih: "If we had a message from [those of] the former peoples,

translations.asad: we would certainly be true servants of God.”
translations.sahih: We would have been the chosen servants of Allah."

translations.asad: And yet, [now that this divine writ has been placed before them,] they refuse to acknowledge it as true! In time, however, they will come to know [what it was that they had rejected]:
translations.sahih: But they disbelieved in it, so they are going to know.

translations.asad: for, long ago has Our word gone forth unto Our servants, the message- bearers,
translations.sahih: And Our word has already preceded for Our servants, the messengers,

translations.asad: that, verily, they - they indeed - would be succoured,
translations.sahih: [That] indeed, they would be those given victory

translations.asad: and that, verily, Our hosts - they indeed - would [in the end] be victorious!
translations.sahih: And [that] indeed, Our soldiers will be those who overcome.

translations.asad: Hence, turn thou aside for a while from those [who deny the truth],
translations.sahih: So, [O Muhammad], leave them for a time.

translations.asad: and see them [for what they are]; and in time they [too] will come to see [what they do not see now].
translations.sahih: And see [what will befall] them, for they are going to see.

translations.asad: Do they, then, [really] wish that Our chas­tisement be hastened on?
translations.sahih: Then for Our punishment are they impatient?

text.arabic: فَإِذَا نَزَلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمْ فَسَآءَ صَبَاحُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ

translations.asad: But then, once it alights upon them, hapless will be the awakening of those who were warned [to no avail]!
translations.sahih: But when it descends in their territory, then evil is the morning of those who were warned.

translations.asad: Hence, turn thou aside for a while from them,
translations.sahih: And leave them for a time.

translations.asad: and see [them for what they are]; and n time they [too] will come to see [what they do not see now].
translations.sahih: And see, for they are going to see.

text.arabic: سُبْحَٰنَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ ٱلْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ

translations.asad: LIMITLESS in His glory is thy Sustainer, the Lord of almightiness, [exalted] above anything that men may devise by way of definition!
translations.sahih: Exalted is your Lord, the Lord of might, above what they describe.

translations.asad: And peace be upon all His message-bearers!
translations.sahih: And peace upon the messengers.

translations.asad: And all praise is due to God alone, the Sus­tainer of all the worlds!
translations.sahih: And praise to Allah, Lord of the worlds.
